elder_miriam_001.speaker: Elder Miriam
elder_miriam_001.text: Welcome, young rider. The legends speak of you.

elder_miriam_002.speaker: Elder Miriam
elder_miriam_002.text: I am Miriam, keeper of the old ways. The egg you found has been waiting for someone special. Someone like you.

kael_rival_001.speaker: Kael
kael_rival_001.text: So you're the one everyone's talking about. The 'chosen rider.' What makes you so special?

choices.text: I don't know. I'm just trying to help.
Maybe I'm just better than you.

levelUp.title: LEVEL UP!
levelUp.text: You are now level {level}! New abilities unlocked!

bondIncrease.title: BOND INCREASED!
bondIncrease.text: Your bond with {creatName} increased to level {bondLevel}!

tutorialMessages.movement: Use WASD or Arrow Keys to move. Hold Shift to sprint.
tutorialMessages.combat: Left Click or Space to attack. Right Click to block.
tutorialMessages.bonding: Press P to pet your creat. Press F to feed. Press Space to play.
tutorialMessages.racing: Hold W to accelerate. Use A/D to steer. Hold Shift for boost.
tutorialMessages.vaultExploration: Explore the vault and collect coins. Press E near the treasure chest to collect loot.

sad.text: {creatName} seems sad. Maybe it needs attention?

scared.text: {creatName} is scared! Comfort it or remove the threat.

navigationPrompts.questMarker: Follow the golden marker to {location}. Distance: {distance}m
navigationPrompts.checkpointReached: Checkpoint reached! Your progress has been saved.
navigationPrompts.playerLost: Check your map (M key) to see where you need to go.
navigationPrompts.vaultEntered: Entered {kingdomName} vault. Collect treasure and coins!
navigationPrompts.tooFarFromTreasure: Get closer to the treasure chest.

combatInstructions.bossStart: Boss Fight: {bossName}! Watch for attack patterns!
combatInstructions.lowHealth: WARNING: Low Health! Use healing potion (H key)!

racingInstructions.driftTutorial: Hold brake + turn to drift! Longer drifts = more boost!
